title: Growth Control Plane analytics and observability governance

phases.objective: Prove version-aware KPI normalization and deterministic tenant-isolated portfolio projections from governed synthetic observations.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Governed KPI definition, activity binding, and normalized observation domain boundary
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A native KPI observation is normalized against the exact governed definition version and appears only in the authorized tenant portfolio projection with immutable lineage and freshness evidence.
steps: Validate the KPI definition and version-aware activity binding identity.
Normalize the native observation through the declared identity or scale conversion.
Preserve native key, unit, definition version, source lineage, confidence, freshness, and observation hash.
Project the normalized observation into the matching tenant portfolio only.
Reject ambiguous versions, tampered normalized values, stale lineage, and cross-tenant observations.
assertions: Historical definition versions can coexist without reinterpreting earlier observations.
An observation identifies its definition version whenever multiple governed mappings are eligible.
Persisted normalized value, lineage, and observation hash remain immutable across mapping lifecycle changes.
Display names never create KPI equivalence and cross-tenant data fails closed.
Caller-supplied clocks cannot control freshness evaluation at the application boundary.

phases.objective: Prove authenticated Admin, Tenant, and backend-only analytics and operational paths with transactional same-cycle persistence readback.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authorized Admin, Tenant user, or backend service principal
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Growth Control Plane analytics and operations HTTP routes
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Read projections remain scope-safe, internal writes accept only a backend service principal, and every accepted synthetic write is transactionally reread and hash-verified before commit.
steps: Resolve the route principal and reject unsupported identity or transport combinations.
Apply Admin, Tenant, field, and resource authority before entering the service boundary.
Validate and persist a normalized observation, SLO sample, or decision-evidence record transactionally.
Reread the persisted authority in the same cycle and compare its immutable identity and hash.
Commit only on exact readback; otherwise roll back with a typed failure.
assertions: User JWT and ordinary API credential principals cannot access internal write operations.
Backend API-key and backend Bearer transports resolve to the same bounded service-principal contract.
Tenant projections cannot request or receive another tenant or platform-wide dashboard scope.
Readback mismatch rolls back the transaction instead of reporting success.
OpenAPI security alternatives and forbidden responses match runtime authentication behavior.

phases.objective: Prove deterministic SLO evaluation, secret-safe operational dashboards, typed alerts, and reconciliation without automatic notification, remediation, or high-risk repair.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Decision evidence and observability sample composition boundary
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Synthetic telemetry and decision evidence produce deterministic SLO, alert, dashboard, and reconciliation projections while unsafe repair, secret exposure, and cross-tenant aggregation remain blocked.
steps: Compose bounded decision evidence and telemetry spans against the governed authority map.
Evaluate the SLO sample using server-owned time and deterministic thresholds.
Project critical or high alerts without dispatching notifications or remediation.
Build Admin or Tenant-safe operational dashboards from authorized records only.
Emit typed reconciliation findings and require explicit authority for any high-risk repair.
assertions: SLO evaluation is deterministic for the same governed evidence and server clock.
Alerts are projections only and cannot send notifications or invoke remediation automatically.
Tenant dashboards never expose platform-wide or cross-tenant operational records.
Unknown, partial, conflicting, or high-risk findings remain explicit and are never silently repaired.
Decision evidence, telemetry, and reconciliation projections exclude secret-bearing fields.

phases.objective: Apply the additive migration and validate the analytics and observability journeys against an explicitly authorized non-production environment with rollback evidence.
Verify the exact Production SHA, migration state, runtime parity, dashboard isolation, SLO evidence, monitoring, and rollback under separate release authorization.
